description: Jordskjelvsoneringskart is a dataset listed in National Single Information Point of Norway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by NORSAR. Stiftelsen NORSAR har etablert et nytt kunnskapsgrunnlag for norsk jordskjelvsonering basert på nye og harmoniserte data, bedre regnemodeller og metodeutvikling fra inn- og utland. Kartet viser sannsynligheten for jordskjelv og hvilket skadepotensiale skjelvene har for hele Norge, inkludert Svalbard. Det nye jordskjelvsoneringskartet er digitalt tilgjengelig. Coverage: NORSAR. The publisher named on the listing is NORSAR. Its keywords include Svalbard, Natural risk zones, Jordskjelv, Norge, Jordskjelvsoneringskart, fellesDatakatalog. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2020-06-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.norsar.no/getfile.php/139126-1585254232/norsar.no/Services/NORSAR-brukervilk%C3%A5r-soneringskart.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nsip-no.
